steps.en: OIC picks the ID and confirms lifting the HST indicator
steps.id: OIC memilih ID dan mengonfirmasi pencabutan indicator HST

steps.en: Name and new address are sent with the confirmation
steps.id: Nama dan alamat baru dikirim bersama konfirmasi

steps.en: The HST indicator is removed from the offender ID
steps.id: Indicator HST dicabut dari ID offender

steps.en: Suspension on all notices under the ID is lifted
steps.id: Suspension pada semua notice di bawah ID itu dicabut

steps.en: The new address becomes the address for letters
steps.id: Alamat baru menjadi alamat tujuan surat

steps.en: The reminder is resent to the new address
steps.id: Reminder dikirim ulang ke alamat baru
steps.why_en: Lifting does not trigger a resend; the notice only moves to its next reminder, and letters are generated manually.
steps.why_id: Pencabutan tidak memicu kirim ulang; notice hanya lanjut ke reminder berikutnya dan surat dibuat manual.

steps.en: Print and postage files go to the vendor
steps.id: File cetak dan pos dikirim ke vendor
steps.why_en: Files are created, but sending to the vendor is switched off in the production settings.
steps.why_id: File dibuat, tetapi pengiriman ke vendor dimatikan di pengaturan production.
